notes.title: Patch Thread 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Small bug fixes for the next couple of minor patches, both for Windows and Mac/Linux.

Patch 1.3.1
- Bug fix: Chat was not showing quite the right characters on Mac and Linux.
- Bug fix: Could not turn off chat in-game if the chat box was empty.

Patch 1.3.0
- Mac and Linux support! Holy molé this took a lot of work.
- Bug fix: Placing a barracks was killing all units on the map on some computers.

Patch 1.2.0 
- In a game lobby you can switch between being a player and a spectator. 
- You can now spectate games in progress. 

Patch 1.1.0 
- Map editor added. 

Patch 1.0.1 
- Bug fix: friend lobbies were showing up multiple times in the Find Lobby list. 
- Bug fix: Mouse was locked into a small region in some situations on some machines. 
- In-game buttons (Barracks, etc) now have a hotkey letter on them. Hotkeys existed before but now they are more easily seen. 
- Find Lobby list now has a refresh button.

notes.title: Mac and Linux Now Supported!
notes.notes:
Huge thanks to everyone who stopped by the booth at PAX to try out We Are Legion, and double thanks to everyone who loved it so much to pick up a copy! As promised, the game is now available for Mac and Linux, so your massive armies are no longer limited by your operating system. In the same update, we pushed a couple of bug fixes. If you were having issues, please make sure the new patch has pushed to your system, then reach out to us if the problem persists.

Now that PAX South is behind us, we're also going to begin setting up things like bracket tournaments. Keep an eye out here and on our Twitter (@PwneeStudios) for more information in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Patch Thread 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Spectator mode is finally here! Took a couple of weeks but we hammered it out. There might be a few small bugs here and there, but we will be polishing this baby up aggressively over the next few days. You can now choose to be a spectator in a lobby rather than a player. You can also join a game in progress. This should make it much easier to have parties of more than 4 people, as well as to see games in progress so that you can join in.

Upcoming:
- Custom maps in multiplayer 
- New game modes
- Co-op maps
